x: However, Nick has never stood on ceremony, and at the conclusion of his stage of 4 miles 176 yards, we were delighted to find him handing over fourth, a few yards in the rear of R.

At four miles Burns (Elswick) was in the lead, followed by Sutherland (Birchfield), Holden (Tipton), Eaton (Salford), Dodd (Wirral), Robinson (Birchfield), Penny (Belgrave) and Weatherill (S.L.H.) Birchfield were said to have six men in 19 at this point, and we looked certain of a place.
We were particularly pleased with our win at Ponders End, for our "B" team finished third—and Birchfield were second. Carter ran a fine race here, losing by inches to R.

Incidentally, it is reckoned the toughest of the lot, being a long, steady climb all the way; and although his Birchfield opponent ran very strongly, Bert increased our advantage to 20 seconds. Arthur Allum, as last year, had been allotted the final stage to Brighton; and although chased by the Scot…
Birchfield countered with 8 and 10, and then came Dan Patience, scoring 11 for us. Birchfield's captain, our old friend, R.
For Birchfield Jack Webster (3 International CC caps including an individual win in 1925) captained a team including R R Sutherland (5 caps who went on to win 2 more) and Forryan (1 cap).
